# Sino Aesthetics

> China-focused cosmetic medical travel information and non-clinical coordination for international patients.

Canonical site: https://sinoaesthetics.com/
Primary language: English. Other interface languages include Chinese, Russian and Spanish.
Last updated: 2026-11-23

Current published library: approximately 256 video cases; the Medora import is still running. Cases without covers remain noindex.

Sino Aesthetics publishes expert profiles, procedure guides and medical-travel planning information. The platform coordinates consultation preparation, appointments, translation and practical travel support when confirmed for an individual itinerary.

Sino Aesthetics is not a hospital, clinic, medical practice or emergency service. It does not diagnose, prescribe, choose a procedure for a patient, control clinical care or guarantee an outcome. Medical assessment, informed consent, treatment, anesthesia and clinical aftercare remain the responsibility of the treating clinician and licensed medical facility. Independently verify current credentials, facility licensing, fees, risks and follow-up arrangements before payment or travel.

## Expert directory

- [Published expert profiles](/doctors): Names, listed specialties and canonical expert profiles with hospital, city and linked case videos.
- [Clinics and hospitals](/clinics): Directory information and published associated experts and cases.

## Case library

- [Published video cases](/cases): Paginated case library, including the ongoing import of approximately 528 Medora source videos. Only published cases with covers are listed for indexing; duplicates and oversized source files are excluded.
- [Before and after](/before-after): Published comparison photographs and video case links.
- [Video sitemap](/sitemap-videos.xml): Indexable case pages with stable video and thumbnail URLs.

- [Travel support](/travel-packages): Non-clinical travel coordination.
